title: An item that waits only on the orchestrator's paid run does not hold its touches against other claims
goal: A claimed item whose code is on main and that waits only on a run the orchestrator makes (a smoke record) is shown by held as waiting, not holding, so held --overlaps does not report its touches against a fix the run itself calls for; SP-2vhfsn4o: ST-xy5kmisr held bench_pool.py, test_bench.py and benchmarks.md through five S1 fixes its smoke records found, each claimed past an overlap exit 1
